review_scope: Renderer-backed close-range review of five project-packaged, independently morphed, rigged CC0 MakeHuman/MPFB guide and crew bodies with photographed skin/eye atlases and the retained project-owned rafting gear overlay.

renderer_evidence.camera_qualification: The guide camera was explicitly activated and assigned as the player-controller view target; the raft and all five rigged production bodies occupy the review frame.

assertions_include: five CC0 rigged bodies loaded with finite poses
all eight CC0 base materials declare SkeletalMesh usage
aimed rescue, flexible fabric, and runtime rescue loop remain functional

accepted_findings: Five distinct rights-compatible bodies replace the blank Manny fallback through the existing production-character adapter without transferring GPL build tooling into the project.

The deterministic source and importer validate SHA-256 provenance, centimeter-scale mesh and reference-skeleton bounds, absence of promoted eye/brow nodes, four material slots, and three skeletal LODs per body.
Photographed CC0 skin and eye atlases, rigged fingers, authored human anatomy, and variant-specific morphology materially improve the close-range crew read.
The retained raft-guide action, rescue, PFD, helmet, boot, and paddle systems remain functional and renderer-backed after the character replacement.
rejected_findings: The MakeHuman bodies and generated material response are a rights-compatible technical fallback, not scanned or MetaHuman-quality photoreal people.
Hair is omitted under the intended helmet workflow, facial nuance is limited, and the procedural neoprene/PFD/helmet silhouettes still read below final character-art quality.
The procedural raft and flat test-tank background remain unsuitable for final marketing or store media.
This diagnostic frame has no named art reviewer, guide reviewer, marketing approval, or release-media approval.
decision: Keep the five packaged CC0 bodies as the deterministic playable fallback and production-adapter proof. Do not close the M9 photoreal character, rafting-gear, raft-art, named-review, or release-media gates. Replace or explicitly approve these assets through named art review, then repeat this close-range renderer test.
